summary.en: A random wallpaper picker for wallpaper hoarders.
summary.zh-CN: 适合壁纸囤积症患者的随机图库筛选工具

description.en: Filters a large photo library on your NAS down to landscape images that are big enough, picks a random batch for macOS folder wallpaper shuffle, and refreshes the system wallpaper so the new batch shows up right away.
description.zh-CN: 从 NAS 上的大型图库里筛出分辨率够高的横屏图片，随机拾一批放进壁纸文件夹给 macOS 轮换，并刷新系统壁纸让新图立刻生效。
